steps.text: Visual C++ v14 runtimes 14.51.36247 (2015-2026) installed (both architectures) with native DLL overrides. Fixes 'Microsoft Visual C++ runtime' errors many games show at launch.

knownIssues.symptom: A game still reports a VC++ runtime error after installing
knownIssues.cause: the game may need an older runtime (2010/2013) or the error text is a generic crash message
knownIssues.fix: open a GitHub issue with the exact error text and the newest log

knownIssues.symptom: A game built with newer tools says Visual C++ is missing although Windows components shows it installed
knownIssues.cause: an environment that got this component from Highball 0.10.22 or older has 14.44.35211, older than the 14.5x runtime such a game asks for (highball#523)
knownIssues.fix: download aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe, open the environment, choose Run a Windows program and pick that file, then press Play again

knownIssues.symptom: Install reported as failed with a number like 102, on a bottle where a game or another installer already added VC++
knownIssues.cause: Microsoft's bundle exits 1638 ('a newer version is already installed'), which POSIX truncates to 102. This recipe pins 14.51.36247, so only a newer runtime already present makes it a no-op.
knownIssues.fix: Fixed in Highball 0.7.15: benign installer exit codes are treated as success and the log records the real Windows code. Nothing to do, the runtimes are already there.

lastVerified.engine: x64-crossover26.3-r31 (candidate, same steps as the shipped engines)
lastVerified.result: The 14.51.36247 installers exit 1 within a second in an environment set to Windows 7 (highball#626), and exit 0 there once these two AppDefaults make the installers see Windows 10. Both runtimes land in system32 and syswow64. Windows 10 environments were already fine.
